grounds: WITHDRAW requested: the finding rests on a redacted read, not on the source. _call_openai builds its auth header by interpolating the resolved api_key variable into an f-string; it contains no asterisk placeholder and no hardcoded literal. Structural proof taken without printing the value: the source has zero asterisk characters in that expression, the interpolation of the resolved variable matches, and no sk- literal exists anywhere in the function. The secret-scrubbing layer rewrites text following the auth scheme token, so a correct interpolation is DISPLAYED as a placeholder to any reader going through that layer -- which is what the round-1 read did. The behaviour is already covered by a passing test that asserts the outgoing header equals the scheme token plus the resolved test key from the provider_keys fixture; tests/test_transport_api.py::TestOpenAI is green (3 passed). Anthropic and Google pass api_key in x-api-key and x-goog-api-key in the same file and were read correctly, because neither header value triggers the scrubber. No code change is warranted: changing correct code to satisfy a redaction artifact would be the actual defect.
